'''Koobis''' was the door guard of the [[Bumani Exchange Corporation]], the legal face of the [[Exchange]]'s presence on [[Citadel Station]]. When [[Meetra Surik]] received a mission from [[Luxa]] to speak with [[Loppak Slusk]], he let the former Jedi [[Skirmishes on Citadel Station|enter]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] then promptly deserted the area.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Exile, as the playable character in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', has the possibility to kill Koobis for not letting him/her into the Exchange headquarters. However, this is a Dark Side option and does not help the Exile getting in.
